plasnewydd_host.text: Welcome in. Scones, jam, cream, and a seat with a view. What more does a person need?
Plas Newydd was the home of the Ladies of Llangollen, Lady Eleanor Butler and Sarah Ponsonby. They arrived in 1780.
They left Ireland, set up house here and became so famous that Wordsworth and the Duke of Wellington came to tea.

then.text: A second one? The Ladies would be shocked. And a bit impressed. Off you go.

else.text: A cream tea for the road? Jam first, then cream. Anyone who says different is from Cornwall.
